children.name: contact-page
children.description: The contact-page module is an entry point in the Public site & treatment catalog domain that renders the salon's public contact page as the ContactPage component (selector marush-contact-page), exposing marushDetails, which appears to be the salon's contact details, to its template. It extends BasePage, passing a new ContactPageMetadata. Its outgoing calls go to base-page, marush-details, page-metadata and routing-translator, and its one incoming edge is a dispatch from routes. The packet lists no flows and no header comment.

children.name: gallery-page
children.description: gallery-page is an entry-point module in the Public site & treatment catalog domain that runs the salon's public photo gallery. It loads image definitions with a GET request, shows them in batches of 9 via loadMoreImages, and opens a chosen photo full-size in a dialog with next and previous navigation. It calls base-page, dialog, image, keyboard-event, loader and page-metadata, and is reached through a dispatch from routes. The packet lists no flows and no data writes.

children.name: discounts
children.description: The discounts module renders the discounts carousel on the salon's public home page (component HomeDiscounts, selector marush-home-discounts), showing the active promotions from currentDiscounts. When more than one discount exists it shows a slider that advances every 10000 milliseconds, lets the visitor go next or previous, and wraps around at either end. Its only outgoing call is to page-metadata.model, from which it reads currentDiscounts; its only incoming call is from home-page. The packet shows no backend calls or writes.

children.name: services
children.description: The services module (component HomeServices, selector marush-home-services) is a section of the public home page in the Public site & treatment catalog domain that appears to promote the salon's treatments. Its redirectToServices action asks RouteTranslator to translate the 'services' path and uses Router to send the visitor to that treatment listing. Its only outgoing call is to routing-translator, and its only incoming caller is home-page. It is not an entry point and takes part in no flows.

children.name: space
children.description: The space module (Site/Gmf.Marush.Care.App/src/app/features/home/space/space.ts, 80 LOC) belongs to the Public site & treatment catalog domain and defines the HomeSpace component, selector marush-home-space, which shows the salon's physical space on the public home page. Its spaceImageUrl function builds image links of the form images/home/space-${position}.png, calling environment for staticContentUrl and reading from Static files marushcare.com/files. Its only caller is home-page, and it is not an entry point.

children.name: type-selector
children.description: The type-selector module, in the Public site & treatment catalog, lets a visitor on the services page choose a treatment type: clicking a type, or pressing a key that counts as an action, selects it, and selecting the same type again clears the choice, after which the component emits the updated selected service. It calls supported-treatments for the list of services, types for SelectedService, keyboard-event for isAction and environment for staticContentUrl, and reads service images from Static files marushcare.com/files. Its only incoming caller is services-page.

children.name: combination-treatments
children.description: The combination-treatments module is part of the public site's treatment catalog, holding the fixed list of combination facial treatments the salon offers, each a TreatmentDefinition with a localized title, name, duration and price, for example "Violeta tretman: Masaža lica + higijensko čišćenje + biološki tretman" (120, 6500) and "Glass skin tretman: mikrodermoabrazija + PRXT33" (45, 7500). It calls treatment-definition and reads Translations sr/en/ru for the titles; its only caller is supported-treatments.

children.name: face-treatments
children.description: The face-treatments module is the public site's catalog of facial services in the "Public site & treatment catalog" domain. It lists treatments such as "Klasičan higijenski tretman" (price 3500, duration 60), "Dermapen" (6500) and "Eye contour" (4500), each with a localized title, name, price, duration and usually a description. It is not an entry point and takes part in no flows. It calls treatment-definition to build each entry and reads Translations sr/en/ru for localized text; supported-treatments calls it.

children.name: appointment-page
children.description: appointment-page is the entry point of the Online booking domain's "Book an appointment online" flow: the page where a customer selects treatments, sees the total cost and duration add up, enters their details and submits a booking request, protected by captcha under the 'APPOINTMENT' action, before navigating to 'request-sent' on success. Its outgoing calls go to appointment, captcha, customer-details, services-selector, summary, request, treatment-definition, routing-translator, page-metadata, base-page, marush-details and user; it reads Translations sr/en/ru, and appointment-routes dispatches it.

children.name: calendar-page
children.description: calendar-page is the Admin calendar entry point behind the "Run the weekly calendar" flow. It shows admins one working week, lets them move to the previous, next or current week, totals the week's money, and opens dialogs to edit entries, answer public appointment requests, write Weekly notes or toggle a NonWorkingDay. It calls calendar, calendar-date, calendar-entry, calendar-entry-dialog, calendar-grid, calendar-note, calendar-note-type, calendar-notes-dialog, calendar-selection, day-info, money-formatter, public-appointment and working-week, and is dispatched by admin-routes.

children.name: calendar-entry-dialog
children.description: calendar-entry-dialog is the Admin calendar dialog in the "Run the weekly calendar" flow where staff create, edit or delete a booking ('Novi termin' for new, 'Termin' for existing), including opening a new entry from a PublicAppointment online request. It calls calendar to createEntry, updateEntry and deleteEntry, and emits conflicted when a save is rejected with HttpStatusCode.Conflict. Its other OUTGOING calls are autocomplete, calendar-entry, calendar-selection, clients, combobox, date-picker, dialog, dialog-operation, entry-dialog-form, input, list and public-appointment; its only INCOMING caller is calendar-page.

children.name: calendar-grid
children.description: calendar-grid is the admin calendar's grid view in the salon booking app: for a set of days it lays out time slots and shows calendar entries, public appointments and notes, letting staff click an entry, an appointment or a daily note, toggle a non-working day, and drag across slots to make a selection. It calls calendar-day-column, calendar-day-header, calendar-entry, calendar-note, calendar-note-type, calendar-selection, calendar-time-slots, day-info, public-appointment and slot-drag. It is called only by calendar-page.

children.name: CustomerController
children.description: CustomerController is an authorized entry point for Customer (CRM) management in the "Look up and update a client record" flow, letting staff fetch one client, list clients with filtering and pagination, and create, update or delete client records. It calls ICustomerRetrievalRepository for reads and ICustomerModificationRepository for writes, uses IUserService to find the acting User, and is guarded by ValidateCaptchaAttribute on create and update. It maps NewCustomerDto, CustomerDto, CustomerDetails, CustomerAppointment, CustomerListItemDto, CustomerFilteredPagination and PaginatedResponse; its only incoming edge is a dispatch from clients.

children.name: clients-page
children.description: clients-page is the admin screen for Customer (CRM) management where staff look up a client and open the client's record to update it. It shows a paginated table of clients with an "Ime i prezime" (full name) column and a "Kontakt" (contact number) column, filtered by name through a name autocomplete or a validated form; clicking a row opens /admin/klijent for that client, and the add action opens it with no id. It calls autocomplete, clients, item, table-metadata and table-pagination, and is an entry point dispatched by admin-routes.

children.name: clients-edit-page
children.description: clients-edit-page is the Customer (CRM) management admin page in the "Look up and update a client record" flow: it loads an existing client by id, or starts a blank Client, and lets admins edit the client's phones, emails and appointments before submitting under the captcha-protected 'CLIENT_EDIT' action and returning to /admin/klijenti. It calls appointment, captcha, clients, date-picker, field-group, input and request, and reads Translations sr/en/ru. It is reached only through a dispatch from admin-routes.

children.name: footer
children.description: The footer node is the shared Footer component (selector marush-footer) that renders the salon site's footer from footer.html and exposes marushDetails for display. It offers redirectToContact, which navigates to the translated 'contact' route when isAction accepts the click or key press. It calls keyboard-event, marush-details and routing-translator, and is called by application. The packet does not include the template, so which details the footer actually displays is not shown.

children.name: autocomplete
children.description: autocomplete is a shared Angular form component (marush-autocomplete) that suggests matching entries while a user types in the salon admin's forms. It waits before searching (debounceMilliseconds = 300), only runs the supplied search once the query is long enough (defaultMinimumQueryLength = 2), shows the results, supports keyboard navigation and cancel, and writes the chosen label into the form control. It calls field, item, keyboard-event, suggestion-commitment and suggestion-navigation, and is called by calendar-entry-dialog and clients-page.

children.name: checkbox
children.description: checkbox is a reusable Angular form control in the salon app's shared components that renders a labelled checkbox (selector marush-checkbox). It takes a required labelText input, a checked flag defaulting to false, and an onChange callback; when the box is ticked or cleared, onCheckedChange passes the event to the caller's onChange handler. The packet lists OUTGOING (0), so it calls nothing, and its only INCOMING edge is a call from services-selector, which appears to be where clients tick salon services.

children.name: combobox
children.description: The combobox node is a shared form component for picking one option from a list, used as a dropdown in booking and admin screens. It takes the item list and a FormGroup, writes the chosen item's value into the form control named by its name, and closes the dropdown; it also works from the keyboard, with arrow keys to move between options and action and cancel keys. It calls combobox-dropdown, item and keyboard-event, and is called by calendar-entry-dialog, customer-details and selector.

children.name: date-picker
children.description: date-picker is a shared form field that lets users pick a date through AirDatepicker and writes the chosen formattedDate into the form control. When no startDate is given it limits choices to today through nextMonth and disables saturday and sunday cells, matching the API's AddMonths(1); a startDate removes those limits. It extends Field, calls keyboard-event (isCancel closes the open picker) and language for the datePickerLocale, and is called by calendar-entry-dialog, clients-edit-page and customer-details.

children.name: input
children.description: This 87-line Angular component, selector marush-input, is the shared form text box used across the salon app's booking, client and sign-in screens. It extends Field, binds to a FormGroup, takes inputs such as type, placeholder, validation and customValidationMessage, and marks the control with a number error when the browser reports bad input in onNumberChanged. Its only outgoing call is to field; it is called by calendar-entry-dialog, calendar-notes-dialog, clients-edit-page, customer-details and login-page. The packet records no flows for it.

children.name: menu
children.description: The menu module (menu.ts) is the salon site's main navigation bar: it shows the Marush logo and an admin logo, each swapping to an "active" image while its route is active or hovered, and switches to a mobile menu with a hamburger button when the screen size requires it. It calls authentication, button, environment, marush-details, menu, menu-items, routing-translator, screen-size and selector, and its only caller is application. The packet does not say which data it reads or writes.

children.name: page-metadata
children.description: page-metadata is the abstract PageMetadata base class that the salon site's pages extend to supply their title, description, keywords, localized URLs and schema.org structured data: a BeautySalon record with address, openingHours and priceRange, and a WebSite record whose actions link to services, gallery, appointment booking, the PDF price list and the three languages. It calls environment, language and marush-details and reads Translations sr/en/ru and Static files marushcare.com/files; it is called by base-page, canonical-url, open-graph, services-metadata, stapler, structured-data, page-metadata.model and page-metadata itself.

children.name: buttons
children.description: The buttons module (PaginationButtons, selector marush-pagination-buttons) provides the page controls for paginated tables in the salon admin app: previous and next actions plus a window of 3 visible page numbers. It works out pageCount from totalCount and pageSize, flags when the user cannot go back past page 1 or forward past the last page, and writes the chosen page into tableMetadata state through pageNumber.set. It calls paginated-request (for PaginatedRequest.defaultPageSize) and table-metadata (TableMetadata, PaginatedResponse), and table-pagination calls it.

children.name: table-pagination
children.description: The table-pagination module is a shared Angular component (selector marush-table-pagination) that shows a paginated table of salon data from a required TableMetadata and a PaginatedResponse. Users can sort by a column only when it is marked sortable; each sort flips descendingSort and resets pageNumber to 1. On the OUTGOING side it calls buttons (PaginationButtons) and table-metadata; on the INCOMING side it is called by clients-page, so it backs the admin client list. The packet does not include its template.

children.name: Translations sr/en/ru
children.description: Translations sr/en/ru is the frontend localization module (534 LOC of json) holding the customer-facing text of the salon site: appointment booking labels, contact details, error messages, route slugs and page titles, treatment names and descriptions, and limited-time discounts. It has 0 outgoing edges and calls nothing; 19 consumers read it, including appointment-page, appointment-routes, request-sent-page, customer-details, clients-edit-page, face-treatments, treatment-definition, page-metadata, services-metadata, routes and error. The excerpt shows only messages.en.json.

children.name: Global styles (SCSS)
children.description: Global styles (SCSS) is the shared stylesheet module at Site/Gmf.Marush.Care.App/src/styles (1314 LOC) that gives the salon web app its common look: main.scss pulls in vendors, core and polyfills partials, while modules supply a %marush-focusable outline, apply-from-tablet and apply-from-desktop breakpoint mixins, and button mixins such as compact-button-size and plain-button. The map lists OUTGOING (0) dependencies and a single INCOMING call from main; the packet does not show which components consume these mixins.

children.name: Labels.Designer
children.description: Labels.Designer is an auto-generated, strongly-typed resource class (Labels) that gives the salon app's notifications and validation messages their localized wording, such as the Serbian subtitles, texts and titles for accepted, rejected and submitted appointment requests (AppointmentAcceptedSubtitle, AppointmentRejectedText, AppointmentSubmitedTitle, BookedTreatments). It has no outgoing dependencies and reads its strings through a ResourceManager for "Gmf.Marush.Care.Api.Resources.Labels". It is called by AppointmentConfirmationTemplate, AppointmentController, AppointmentRejectionTemplate, AppointmentRequestValidator, AppointmentRescheduledHandler, AppointmentRescheduledTemplate, AppointmentSubmittedTemplate and ValidatorExtensions.

children.name: AppointmentDto
children.description: AppointmentDto is the stored record for one salon appointment: customer, phone, email, language, scheduled start, expected end, description, money, online-booking flag, treatments and status, falling back to a DefaultDuration of one hour when no end is set. It maps itself to CalendarAppointment and AppointmentStatus, replaces its treatments, assigns a Customer and schedules through CalendarSlot. It calls AppointmentTreatmentDto, CustomerDto, CustomerPhoneDto, CustomerEmailDto, CalendarPeriod and EntityDto, and is called by AppointmentRepository, CalendarRetrievalRepository, CustomerModificationRepository and AppointmentConfiguration.

children.name: AppointmentRepository
children.description: AppointmentRepository is the Persistence module that saves salon bookings in the flows "Book an appointment online" and "Accept or reject a booking from email": it records a new appointment for a Customer or ExistingCustomer with the given Period and TreatmentSelection, and applies an AppointmentDecision that changes the booking's status. It reads the SQL tables AppointmentStatus, Appointments, CustomerEmails, CustomerPhones and Customers, and writes Appointments and Customers. Its calls include AppointmentDto, CustomerDto, CustomerEmailDto and CustomerPhoneDto; it is called by RepositoryModule and dispatched via IAppointmentRepository.

children.name: CalendarModificationRepository
children.description: CalendarModificationRepository is the Persistence component behind the "Run the weekly calendar" flow that adds, updates and deletes the calendar entries tied to salon appointments and upserts or deletes calendar notes, returning false and changing nothing when the target entry or customer does not exist. It calls CalendarEntry, CalendarEntryAppointments, CalendarEntryDto, CalendarNote, CalendarNoteDto and Period, implements ICalendarModificationRepository, and reads and writes the SQL tables CalendarEntries and CalendarNotes. RepositoryModule calls it, and calls reach it through ICalendarModificationRepository.

children.name: CalendarRetrievalRepository
children.description: CalendarRetrievalRepository is the read-side Persistence module behind the "Run the weekly calendar" flow: it fetches the admin calendar entries and notes for a week, the public appointments that do not yet have an entry, checks whether a booking's slot is already taken, and finds an appointment's contact email and language. It reads the SQL tables Appointments, CalendarEntries and CalendarNotes, and calls CalendarWeekRange, CalendarSlot, CalendarBooking, AppointmentStatus, AppointmentDto, CalendarEntryDto and CalendarNoteDto. It is called by RepositoryModule and dispatched via ICalendarRetrievalRepository.

children.name: CustomerModificationRepository
children.description: CustomerModificationRepository is the Persistence module behind the "Look up and update a client record" flow: it deletes a client record, or stores CustomerDetails by creating or updating a client together with the client's phones, emails and Performed appointments. It reads the SQL tables Customers, CustomerPhones, CustomerEmails, Appointments, AppointmentStatus and Users, and writes Customers, CustomerPhones, CustomerEmails and Appointments. It calls CustomerDto, AppointmentDto, AppointmentStatusDto, UserDto and AppointmentStatus, among others, and is called by RepositoryModule and dispatched via ICustomerModificationRepository.

children.name: EF Migrations (InitialCreate)
children.description: EF Migrations (InitialCreate) is a Persistence job that creates the initial database schema for the salon booking and admin app: customer records with contact details and properties, user accounts, appointments with statuses and treatments, and calendar entries and notes. It writes the SQL tables AppointmentStatus, AppointmentTreatments, Appointments, CalendarEntries, CalendarNotes, CustomerEmails, CustomerPhones, CustomerProperties, Customers and Users. It is not an entry point and has no flows of its own; it is dispatched by build.yaml and update-database.yaml.

children.name: ApiRunner
children.description: ApiRunner is the shared startup routine for the salon app's web API in the "API hosting platform" domain. Extending ApplicationRunner, it sets up dependency injection, adds the standard services and the request pipeline, and then starts the application. Its outgoing calls go to ApplicationRunner, AspireExtensions, AutofacExceptionMiddleware, Extensions, HandlingExtensions, SecurityExtensions and ValidationExtensions, together covering service discovery, error wrapping, exception handling, security and request validation. Its only incoming caller is Program; the packet lists no flows and no direct data reads or writes.

children.name: HandlingExtensions
children.description: HandlingExtensions is the API hosting platform's central safety net that turns errors in the salon app's backend into consistent responses: a ValidationException, such as a bad booking or admin form submission, returns a 400 "application/problem+json" result, while any other exception is logged as "Unexpected error", returns a 500 with "An unexpected error occurred!" and, outside development, emails the developer through ISendEmail and DeveloperContact. It calls ContextExtensions, DeveloperContact, Extensions, ISendEmail and Request, and is called by ApiRunner.

children.name: Program
children.description: Program is the entry point of the API hosting platform: it starts the Marush web API and sets up hosting for the site's built front end. Through ApiRunner it registers MarushCareContext for data access, AuthenticationExtensions, CaptchaSettings and ValidateCaptchaAttribute for captcha checks, LocalizationMiddleware, DateOnlyJsonConverter, SwaggerExtensions with OpenApiSettings and ApiDetails, and the hosted services AuditLoggingService and NodeJsRunnerService, among its 16 OUTGOING calls. Its 2 INCOMING dispatches come from Program and web.config (IIS).

children.name: build.yaml
children.description: build.yaml is the Build job that turns the salon booking/admin web app's source into deployable packages: it installs node modules, runs linting, builds the Angular Application in production configuration and compiles the .Net code in Release for win-x64, and only main publishes artifacts, including an Entity Framework bundle for MarushCareContext plus appsettings.json. It is called by azure-pipelines.yml and dispatches to EF Migrations (InitialCreate) and web.config (IIS).

children.name: environment-deploy.yaml
children.description: environment-deploy.yaml is the job template that releases the salon app to one environment: it downloads and extracts the Gmf.Marush.Care.App.zip artifact, copies Robots.txt and, for Production only, sitemap.xml, replaces tokens, puts up app_offline.htm, calls update-database.yaml, and deploys to IIS; a condition: always() step takes the offline page down, followed by a smoke_test job. It is called by azure-pipelines.yml, calls backup-database.yaml (when shouldBackUpDatabase) and update-database.yaml, and dispatches to web.config (IIS).

children.name: web.config (IIS)
children.description: web.config (IIS) is the hosting configuration for the salon site's API: it runs the app through AspNetCoreModuleV2, warms it up via /robots.txt after every recycle, redirects visitors at the root to their language cookie or /sr/početna/, forwards sr, en and ru page routes to the Node SSR server, serves app_offline.htm during maintenance, and adds security headers such as Content-Security-Policy and SameSite=strict. It dispatches to Program and server, and is dispatched by build.yaml and environment-deploy.yaml.

observations: Highest fan-in nodes (most depended on): locale (25), Customer (24), Extensions (23), environment (19), language (15). Changes there ripple widest; they are the first candidates for characterization tests.

Tables with more than one writing repository: Appointments <- AppointmentRepository, CalendarEntryAppointments, CustomerModificationRepository; Customers <- AppointmentRepository, CustomerModificationRepository.

The production SSR server is a single child process started by NodeJsRunnerService and reached only through the IIS rewrite in web.config: one point of failure for every public page, with no restart or health check.

Convention-registered nodes kept out of deadEnds (they have no static inbound edge but are wired by assembly scanning / EF / FluentValidation): {'AbstractValidator': 5, 'IEntityTypeConfiguration': 4, 'IDesignTimeDbContextFactory': 1}.
Ambiguous C# type names resolved to the first visible match (possible mis-wired edges): none.
CustomerController talks to repositories directly (no service layer), unlike the other three controllers; it is the cleanest extraction candidate for a service layer.

flows.name: Book an appointment online
flows.description: A customer picks treatments and a time on the website and asks the salon to book it.

steps.label: Send the request with a captcha check
Check the request is valid and inside the booking window
Save the customer and the requested appointment
Email the owner (with Accept/Reject links) and the customer

flows.name: Accept or reject a booking from email
flows.description: The owner opens the booking email and clicks Accept or Reject; the customer is told the outcome.

steps.label: Open the request email and click Accept or Reject
Record the decision while the request is still pending
Email the customer the confirmation or rejection

flows.name: Run the weekly calendar
flows.description: Staff log in, see the week, add or move appointments and notes; moved clients get an email.

steps.label: Add or edit an entry in the dialog
Reschedule: raise an event and email the client

flows.name: Look up and update a client record
flows.description: Staff search the client list, open a client, and save changed contact or treatment details.
